spec.query: SELECT mean("ssl_e2e_ns_avg") AS "e2e avg" FROM "XdpConnStats" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$Host$/) AND "source" = 'eag' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "endpoint", "conn_id", "source" fill(null)

SELECT "ssl_hw2q_ns_max", "ssl_qwait_cyc_max", "ssl_decrypt_cyc_max", "ssl_ws2spmc_cyc_max", "ssl_e2e_ns_max"
FROM "XdpConnStats"
WHERE ("host"::tag =~ /^$Host$/) AND $timeFilter AND "source" = 'eag'
GROUP BY "host"::tag, "source"::tag

SELECT "count" FROM /^(XDPTxQWakeup|XdpSslWsFrameCount|XdpSslBytesDecrypted|XdpSslBytesPayload|XdpDirectDecryptStash|XdpDirectDecryptHit|WsPingPongCount|WsParseErrorCount|PktQueueLatencySpikeCount|FhProbeRecordCount|FhProbeSeqnumHitCount|FhProbeMultiFrameCount|FhProbeEarlySkipCount|FhProbeFramesSkipped|FhProbeFramesDelivered|FhProbeCrossRecordSkipCount|FhDedupCheckEntered|FhDedupSpansRecords|FhDedupJsonParsed|FhDedupIsDuplicate|FhDedupSymbolMiss|FhSpscMessagesRead|FhSpscOrderbookUpdates|FhSpscBboUpdates|FhSpscTradeUpdates|FhSpscBatchTrades|FhSpscMarkPriceUpdates|FhSpscFundingUpdates|FhSpscPerpContextUpdates)$/ WHERE ("source" = 'eag') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"::tag

SELECT sum("count") FROM /^(XDPTxQWakeup|XdpSslWsFrameCount|XdpSslBytesDecrypted|XdpSslBytesPayload|XdpDirectDecryptStash|XdpDirectDecryptHit|WsPingPongCount|WsParseErrorCount|PktQueueLatencySpikeCount|FhProbeRecordCount|FhProbeSeqnumHitCount|FhProbeMultiFrameCount|FhProbeEarlySkipCount|FhProbeFramesSkipped|FhProbeFramesDelivered|FhProbeCrossRecordSkipCount|FhDedupCheckEntered|FhDedupSpansRecords|FhDedupJsonParsed|FhDedupIsDuplicate|FhDedupSymbolMiss|FhSpscMessagesRead|FhSpscOrderbookUpdates|FhSpscBboUpdates|FhSpscTradeUpdates|FhSpscBatchTrades|FhSpscMarkPriceUpdates|FhSpscFundingUpdates|FhSpscPerpContextUpdates)$/ WHERE ("host" =~ /^$Host$/) AND "source" = 'eag' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "source" fill(null)

SELECT sum("tcp_seq_gaps"), sum("tcp_dup_pkts"), sum("tcp_dupacks_tx"), sum("tcp_dupacks_rx"), sum("tcp_fast_retx"), sum("tcp_bytes_retx"), sum("tcp_retx_blocked"), sum("tcp_bytes_rx"), sum("tcp_bytes_tx"), sum("tcp_pkts_rx"), sum("tcp_ttl_chg"), sum("tcp_ipid_reorder"), sum("tcp_ipid_gap"), mean("tcp_buffered_pkts"), mean("tcp_retx_buf_bytes") FROM "XdpConnStats" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$Host$/) AND "source" = 'eag' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "endpoint", "conn_id", "source" fill(null)

SELECT mean("average") FROM /^(OgTotalProcessingNanos|OgTotalProcessingSendOrderNanos|OgTotalProcessingCancelByClientOrderIdNanos|OgSelectSocketsNanos|OgPrepareJsonRequestNanos|OgConnManagerSendRequestNanos|OgWsDispatchNanos|OgSendOrderBuildAndPendingCreateNs|OgSendOrderPendingEmplaceNs|OgSendOrderInitStoreUpdateNs|OgSendOrderDispatchAndPostNs|OgSendOrderTradingReadyCheckNs|OgSendOrderStrategyToOgWaitNs)$/ WHERE ("host" =~ /^$Host$/) AND "source" = 'eag' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "source" fill(null)

SELECT mean("average"), max("max") FROM /^(XDPTxGetWriteBuffNs|XDPTxPreparePacketNs|XDPUdpClientPollNs|XDPUdpClientPostProcessNs|XDPUdpHbServicedNs|XDPHwPreDispatchNs|XDPHwPostDispatchNs|XdpHwSwTimestampDiffNs|EpollNs|XdpPollPreOverheadNs)$/ WHERE ("host" =~ /^$Host$/) AND "source" = 'xdp' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT mean("average"), max("max") FROM /^(ExchGWOnMsgTotalMicros|ExchGWEventTypeMicros|ExchGWDedupMicros|ExchGWOrderStoreMicros|ExchGWJsonParseMicros|ExchGWConvertMicros|ExchGWPublishMicros)$/ WHERE ("host" =~ /^$Host$/) AND "source" =~ /^(eag)$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT mean("average"), max("max") FROM /^(XdpSslHwToQueueInsertNs|XdpSslQueueWaitCycles|XdpSslDecryptionCycles|XdpSslWsParseCycles|XdpSslWsToSpmcQueueCycles|XdpSslTotalLatencyNs|XdpSslInternalProcessingCycles|XdpSslOnMessageCycles|WorkerClaimCycles|PktQueueLatencyCycles)$/ WHERE ("host" =~ /^$Host$/) AND "source" =~ /^(erh)$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "source" fill(null)

SELECT mean("average"), max("max") FROM /^(ExchGWOnMsgTotalMicros|ExchGWEventTypeMicros|ExchGWDedupMicros|ExchGWPfillDedupMicros|ExchGWOrderStoreMicros|ExchGWJsonParseMicros|ExchGWExchToRecvMicros|ExchGWConvertMicros|ExchGWPublishMicros)$/ WHERE ("host" =~ /^$Host$/) AND "source" =~ /^(erh)$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT mean("ssl_hw2q_ns_avg"), max("ssl_hw2q_ns_max"), mean("ssl_qwait_cyc_avg"), max("ssl_qwait_cyc_max"), mean("ssl_decrypt_cyc_avg"), max("ssl_decrypt_cyc_max"), mean("ssl_ws2spmc_cyc_avg"), max("ssl_ws2spmc_cyc_max"), mean("ssl_e2e_ns_avg"), max("ssl_e2e_ns_max") FROM "XdpConnStats" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$Host$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "endpoint", "role" fill(null)
